tools.name: coder_library_search
tools.description: Search libraries for the active Aily Coder project through one unified entry. By default it searches the shared Blockly @aily-project/lib-* catalog, which is always preferred. Only when those results are unsuitable, call the same tool again with candidates=true to search the official Arduino catalog for fallback candidates. Copy libraryRef and version exactly from a result.

query.description: Prefer an exact library name when known. Additional functionality keywords are ranking hints; verify actual capabilities from result metadata and the installed API.

candidates.description: False searches preferred shared Blockly libraries; true searches official Arduino fallback candidates.

forceRefresh.description: Refresh the official Arduino candidate index when candidates=true.

tools.name: coder_library_install
tools.description: Install one exact result from coder_library_search and wait until it is ready on disk. Preferred shared results keep the @aily-project/lib-* package intact under node_modules and safely expand src.7z in place as that package's src/... tree; the result returns packageDirectory, sourceDirectory, and exact libraryRoots that already exist. Official Arduino candidates are supported only as the fallback tier. Copy libraryRef and version exactly; do not guess paths or either value.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef returned by coder_library_search.

version.description: Exact returned version. Required for official Arduino candidates and used when present for preferred Blockly packages.

tools.name: coder_library_remove
tools.description: Remove one exact result previously installed through coder_library_install. Preferred shared results are unlinked from root package.json and removed as one intact node_modules/@aily-project/lib-* package, including its generated src tree; verified legacy sketch/libraries projections are cleaned during migration. Official Arduino candidates retain their existing managed-provenance protection.

libraryRef.description: Exact opaque libraryRef originally returned by coder_library_search.

version.description: Exact installed version. Required for official Arduino candidates.
